data.narrative:
Fourth Power is a Series A climate and energy technology company founded by Asegun Henry and Arvin Ganesan, having raised $40M+ to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix, though none provide sufficient overlap on stage and valuation tier for reliable peer-median analysis.

The valuation analysis applies a single applicable method: stage-progression analysis. Using the $40M total raised as a proxy for enterprise value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, this method implies an $80M valuation. This multiplier reflects the capital infusion and company development expected between Series A and the subsequent funding round.

Peer-median analysis is not applicable due to insufficient comparable data points at the same stage and tier within the narrower Climate & Energy cohort. The triangulated valuation range supported by this analysis is $68M to $92M, with a median point of $80M. Key uncertainties include the accuracy of the raised-capital proxy as a valuation anchor, stage-specific multiplier variability across climate-tech subsectors, and the limited single-method foundation. A more robust range would require either closer-stage private comparables or quantitative metrics (revenue, burn rate, unit economics) not available in this dataset.
